purpose: Canonical ownership/conservation contract for geography-aware world representation. This class model constrains runtime/data design; exact mutable facts remain in their domain owners.

state_force.rule: available_by_location and cohort reserve_by_location partition the same force bodies; they are not second owners

house_private_force.rule: state service or player command never transfers manpower title without an explicit lawful transfer

owns: only bodies actually transferred/recruited into that exact personal force
personal_force.rule: assigned House or state formations remain owned by their source forces

owns: institutional people only where an exact institutional force/manpower owner exists
institutional_manpower.rule: institution staff/capacity fields do not become field troops unless current exact authority says so

mercenary_company.rule: employer/contract never duplicates or transfers company bodies

capability_profile.rule: a capability profile never proves a current troop pool exists

regional_military_disposition.rule: nested inside the exact force owner

formation.rule: personnel are allocated from exact source force/manpower ancestry

mount_pool.rule: regional reserve + formation allocations equals exact type totals

depot_inventory.rule: surrounding rural population/economy belongs to legitimate demographic/economic owners

location.rule: demographic eligibility is explicit; facilities do not become regions

strategic_route.rule: aliases and route indexes never become competing route owners

route_state.rule: route state never replaces static route identity

fortification_blueprint.rule: never overwrites already materialized damage/repair state

materialized_fortification.rule: child facilities inherit enclosure without duplicating wall authority

polity.rule: territory, population, treasury, forces and occupation remain linked exact owners rather than being duplicated into polity prose

critical_distinctions: static fortification blueprint != current damaged fortification state
